note: Both texts of the preface ('Cum mihi in mentem uenit … Ego id existi-') and the 'Geometria. Arithmetica.' margin agree with the leaf; the two differ only in how they describe the library stamp.
Both have the same body text, but Y gives the signature as 'B' (the leaf shows 'H'), swaps the printed virgules for commas, and joins the catchword into 'Gutdünken'.

X makes up stamp texts ('EX BIBLIOTHECA REGIA BEROLINENSI', 'BIBLIOTHEQUE NATIONALE') where the leaf reads 'BIBLIOTH. IMPERIALE IMPR.' and 'BIBLIOTHEQUE DU TRIBUNAT', misreads 'Oxonienfi', and leaves out the manuscript corrections 'principatus'/'virtutes' that Y records.

X describes the diagrams accurately and places 'Figura musice' below the frame; Y guesses '<unclear>Lira</unclear>' and describes 'four semicircular diagrams' at the bottom, where the leaf has two circles.
Y numbers the new psalm 'קב' where the leaf has 'קג' (Ps. 103), misreads the foot note as 'בכל גגג ומימ … ערוכה', and runs the marginal Masorah together into a jumbled list.
Y puts the Sagittarius-row '4' under ☊ (the leaf has it under ☋), silently changes the misprinted second ♍ row to ♏, and has misreadings such as 'Loniunctio', 'Laput', 'Lauda' and 'The dignitates'.
Y follows the print with 'gradirt', 'RIPLÆI' and 'Aquæ'; X has 'gradiert' and 'RIPLEI'. Otherwise the texts are the same.
The body texts are identical, but Y adds a page number '93' and a signature 'J.' that do not appear on this leaf.
X runs the foot-line 'Tom. III.' into the note ('dixi ad *Tom. III.*'), but the note actually continues 'ad Iuuencum lib. 4'. Otherwise the texts match.
Y reads 'Idem Temen.' as printed, where X has 'Timen'. Y also records the catchword 'tes'. The wording is otherwise the same.
